strings.jp:
あんた敵の大将だね?
覚悟してもらうよ!
strings.en:
You're the enemy boss,
right? Brace yourself!

strings.jp:
貴様ら雑魚には用は無い!
命が悩しければ去るがいい!
strings.en:
I have no use for small fry!
Begone, if you value life!

strings.jp:
き、貴様…
ただの雑魚ではない…な……?
strings.en:
Y-you... You are no mere
small fry... are you...?

strings.jp: うわっ…つ、強いじゃない……
その程度では俺は倒せん!
strings.en:
That will not
be enough to defeat me!
